# EfficientAD-M Teacher

Anomaly Detection · `efficientad-m-teacher_256x256` · DX-APP Python example

Anomaly Detection model, evaluated on MVTecAD.

**Input** 256 × 256 × 3 · **Dataset** MVTecAD · **License** Apache-2.0 · **Quantization** Q-Lite

![EfficientAD-M Teacher output](result.webp)

Full card with copy buttons and dark/light theme (open it in a browser; GitHub shows its source): [model.html](model.html)

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models efficientad_m_teacher_256x256
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/anomaly_detection/efficientad/efficientad-m-teacher_256x256/efficientad-m-teacher_256x256_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/efficientad-m-teacher_256x256.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_parking.jpg
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target efficientad-m-teacher_256x256_sync   # once
./bin/efficientad-m-teacher_256x256_sync \
  -m assets/models/efficientad-m-teacher_256x256.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_parking.jpg
```
